newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Bank of Cyprus Q3 operating profit rises 9.15pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Cyprus Q3 operating profit rises 9.15pct.

text.p: The Bank of Cyprus on Wednesday announced operating profits of the group grew 9.15 percent to 29.8 million Cyprus pounds until the third quarter of the year.
This compared to 27.3 million made in the first three quarters of 1995, a statement released by the chairman's office said.
"This growth is considered satisfactory taking into account the low growth of the Cyprus economy during the current year," the statement said.
The economy's growth is expected to be around 2.5 percent in 1996, compared to a registered growth of five percent in 1995. Official forecasts put the rate of growth at 3.5 percent in 1997.
The growth decline has been attributed to a drop in tourist arrivals by around four percent. Tourism represents 20 percent of Cyprus's gross domestic product.
